note: Structured BIS hallmarking knowledge. Every factual record here was transcribed from an official BIS document that is ingested into this corpus, and carries clause_keywords so its citation is resolved live against that document rather than stored as quoted text. Nothing in this file is written from general knowledge: if a value is not in the ingested sources it is absent, and the API reports UNABLE_TO_VERIFY for it.

scheme.name: BIS Hallmarking Scheme
scheme.summary: Hallmarking is the accurate determination and official recording of the proportionate content of precious metal in precious metal articles. Hallmarks are official marks used in India as a guarantee of purity or fineness.

purity_grades.note: Added to IS 1417 by amendment. The mandatory hallmarking order covers 14, 18 and 22 carat.

hallmark_components.name: BIS Mark
hallmark_components.description: The BIS logo, applied by the recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre.

hallmark_components.name: Purity / fineness mark
hallmark_components.description: Purity in carat and fineness for gold (for example 22K916, 18K750, 14K585); for silver, the fineness alone.

hallmark_components.name: Six-digit alphanumeric HUID
hallmark_components.description: A unique six-digit alphanumeric code generated from the BIS server for each jewellery article and laser-marked by the Assaying & Hallmarking Centre, alongside the BIS logo and the purity mark. In force for gold jewellery/artefacts from 1 July 2021.

consumer_checks.text: Look for the three marks that hallmarked gold jewellery carries since 1 July 2021: the BIS mark, the purity/fineness mark, and the six-digit alphanumeric HUID.
Check that the purity mark is one BIS permits for that metal - for gold, markings such as 22K916, 18K750 or 14K585.
A consumer can have jewellery tested at a BIS recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre.
clause_keywords: Check testing of Hallmarked/Unhallmarked articles by Consumer

consumer_checks.text: If a hallmarked article is found short of the marked purity, BIS Rules provide for compensation to the buyer.
Complaints can be registered with BIS, including through the BIS CARE mobile app and the online complaint portal.

process_stages.title: Confirm hallmarking applies to you
process_stages.summary: Mandatory hallmarking applies to gold jewellery and artefacts in the districts and carats named by the order.
what_you_do: Check whether your district is covered by the mandatory hallmarking order.
Check the carats covered - the order names 14, 18 and 22 carat gold.
clause_keywords: Quality control order for mandatory hallmarking

process_stages.title: Register as a BIS jeweller
process_stages.summary: A jeweller who wants to sell hallmarked jewellery must obtain registration from BIS. The process is online.
what_you_do: Complete the application on the BIS / NSWS portal.
clause_keywords: has to obtain a registration from BIS

process_stages.title: Submit articles to a recognised A&H Centre
process_stages.summary: The registered jeweller submits jewellery for hallmarking to a BIS recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre.
what_you_do: Choose a BIS recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre.
Submit the hallmarking request; the centre records the inward receipt and weighment.

process_stages.title: Assaying and testing
process_stages.summary: The centre tests the article against the relevant Indian Standard.
what_you_do: The centre carries out the testing steps recorded in the BIS workflow, which include XRF, sampling and fire assay.

process_stages.title: Hallmarking and HUID
process_stages.summary: A unique six-digit alphanumeric code is generated from the BIS server for each article and laser-marked with the BIS logo and purity mark.
what_you_do: The centre applies the hallmark to articles meeting the requirement of the standard.
The HUID is laser-marked alongside the BIS logo and purity mark.
clause_keywords: laser marked by the assaying and hallmarking centre
unique six digit alpha numerical code

process_stages.title: Ongoing obligations and surveillance
process_stages.summary: After registration BIS periodically visits sales outlets, draws samples of hallmarked articles and has them tested.
what_you_do: Keep selling only hallmarked articles that meet the marked purity.
Expect periodic market surveillance and audit of the centre.

huid.description: A unique six-digit alphanumeric code generated from the BIS server for each hallmarked article and laser-marked on it by the Assaying & Hallmarking Centre.
clause_keywords: unique six digit alpha numerical code
huid.verification_note: This platform does not hold, and is not connected to, the BIS HUID verification service. It can explain what a HUID is and where BIS publishes verification, but it cannot confirm that any particular HUID is genuine.
